text:
Maya: Quick sync — launching a 30m mini-webinar + starter pack tomorrow. Plan = demo (10m) + prompt templates (10m) + Q&A + 3-day activation nudges. Need distribution, routing, and benchmark narrative. Who's in?
Sam: I can take distribution. Proposal: LinkedIn post + 2 x email sends + in-console banner. A/B subject: "Try Redwood Mini-Webinar: free prompt pack" vs "Ship LLM features faster — join our mini-demo". :eyes:
Leo: For benchmarks, measure: registrant->signup rate, signup->first-generation (24h), and 7-day retention of usage. Also capture avg tokens/session and top-used template. Frame as "Launch baseline: activation & cost per activation".
Anita: Copy draft (short-form + email intro). Please feedback.
Anita: "LinkedIn post —
Join our 30-minute mini-webinar: ship LLM features faster. Well demo three starter prompt templates and grant attendees free credits to test in your account. RSVP → seats limited.
Register: https://redwood.ai/miniwebinar?utm=miniweb-mar"
Anita: Email subject variants:
1) Try Redwood Mini-Webinar: free prompt pack
2) Ship LLM features faster — join our mini-demo
Email snippet:
"Hey — quick invite: Join us for a 30-minute demo where we walk through 3 starter prompts and give attendees credits to try inside their account. RSVP → (link)"
Devin: Routing / infra note: inbound regs should include ?src=miniweb_mar. We can auto-provision 200 starter credits on first login if lead has src=miniweb_mar and no prior usage. Ill add lead tag webinar:miniweb_mar.
Maya: yes to 200 credits. Also we want to flag heavy trialers for SDR follow-up: usage > 100k tokens in 7 days -> tag "power_trial".
Devin: config snippet Ill use:
```
rules:
  - if query.src == 'miniweb_mar' then tag: webinar_miniweb_mar
  - if new_user and not credited then grant_credits: 200
  - monitor window: 7d token_usage > 100000 -> tag: power_trial
```
Devin: will push rule to staging by 11:30 PT.
Sam: Distribution timing — LinkedIn + blog at T-24h, email1 T-12h, email2 T-1h, banner live T-12h. Also add post in community Slack + partners DM list.
Anita: Prompt templates — short list (3):
- "Summarize meeting notes to action items" (for product teams)
- "Customer support triage + suggested reply" (support)
- "User persona content generator" (marketing)
Anita: Ill attach full prompt pack doc to the deck.
Leo: Experiment matrix idea: vary credit amount (100 vs 200), prompt pack variant (A: product/support/marketing vs B: vertical-specific), and CTA language (demo-first vs credits-first). Goal: find best cost-per-activation.
Maya: Good. Let's keep matrix small: 2x2x2 => 8 cells.
Sam: I'll wire tracking params: credit_amt, pack_variant, cta_variant. Also add UTM to all links.
Maya: Onboard nudges — Sam & Anita, can we do 3 drips?
Sam: yes: Day0 welcome (how to use prompt pack), Day2 "try this prompt" with short tutorial, Day5 personalized tip + invite to office hours.
Anita: I'll write the micro-copy for each drip. Keep under 2 short bullets each.
Devin: One ops ask: when we auto-grant credits, ensure console shows source + expiration TTL (30 days). Ill include that in the grant API response.
growthbot: [automated] Draft dashboard created: /dashboards/marketing/miniweb_1739993333 — includes registrant funnel, token usage, credit burn, and experiment cell breakdown.
Sam: Nice. Can we have a widget for median latency and avg token cost per generation? Useful for product narrative.
Leo: For the benchmark narrative, propose 3 slides: 1) baseline funnel + KPIs, 2) cost-per-activation breakdown by cell, 3) recommendations (scale winners + optimize batching/quantization suggestions).
Maya: Assignments: Sam -> distribution + tracking. Anita -> copy + prompt pack. Devin -> routing + credit grant rules. Leo -> benchmark deck + slide templates. Ill own webinar logistics and deck collab.
Sam: I'll post final schedule in #marketing in 30m. 
Anita: uploading prompt pack doc to the drive and will link in the deck.
Devin: pushed rules to staging, tagging Maya for review: https://staging.redwood.ai/rules/1739993333
Maya: review incoming, please react with :thumbsup: when youve read. Launch cadence looks good — green to go pending minor copy tweaks.
